pattern.description: After switching to the Roadmap view, a post-production camera push-in (about 1.19x, drifting up and slightly left) crops away the browser chrome and sidebar so the three-column Later / Next / Now board fills the frame.
pattern.why_premium: The push-in removes navigation clutter and enlarges the idea cards to legible size exactly when the narrator talks about communicating across the company, so the viewer's attention lands on the board without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: Wrap the recording in a stage and gsap.fromTo('.stage', {scale: 1, xPercent: 0, yPercent: 0}, {scale: 1.19, xPercent: 2, yPercent: 7, transformOrigin: '50% 0%', duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.out'}); fire the card hover class and cursor move (gsap.to('.cursor', {x, y, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.inOut'})) during the settle.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 140, mass: 1}}) (critically damped, no overshoot); transform: scale(interpolate(p, [0, 1], [1, 1.19])) translate(interpolate(p, [0, 1], [0, 2])%, interpolate(p, [0, 1], [0, 7])%) with transformOrigin '50% 0%'.

notes: camera.move is push_in (scale 1.19, pan_y -0.14); energy ramps down monotonically over ~10 frames, consistent with an ease-out zoom. Individual cards and toolbar buttons only move because of the camera, so they are not listed separately. No SFX candidates.
